sentences.text: Day 3 – Night Routine Every night after putting on my PJs, I wash my face and take all my makeup off.
sentences.text_ko: 3일 차, 밤 루틴이에요. 잠옷으로 갈아입고 나면 세안하고 화장도 다 지워요.

sentences.text: I start by removing my eyeliner and mascara with some makeup remover.
Then I cleanse my face with a foam cleanser.
After I rinse off all the cleanser, I pat my face dry with a towel.
sentences.text_ko: 클렌저를 다 헹군 다음엔 수건으로 톡톡 두드려서 물기를 닦아요.

sentences.text: Next, I put on some moisturizer.
For the final step of my skincare routine, I apply a bit of eye cream to help prevent wrinkles.
sentences.text_ko: 스킨케어 마지막 단계로 주름 예방하려고 아이크림을 조금 발라요.

sentences.text: Once my face is nice and clean, I light a candle.
I love how cozy they make my house feel.
sentences.text_ko: 집이 훨씬 아늑해지는 느낌이 들어서 좋아요.

sentences.text: Then I head to the kitchen to make a hot cup of tea.
sentences.text_ko: 그다음엔 부엌으로 가서 따뜻한 차를 한 잔 만들어요.

sentences.text: I fill the electric kettle and boil some water.
I put a peppermint tea bag in my mug and pour the boiling water over it.
sentences.text_ko: 머그컵에 페퍼민트 티백을 넣고 끓인 물을 부어요.

sentences.text: After the tea cools down a bit, I take my first sip.
sentences.text_ko: 차가 조금 식으면 첫 모금을 마셔요.

sentences.text: While enjoying my tea, I journal and read a few pages of a book.
sentences.text_ko: 차 마시면서 일기도 쓰고 책도 몇 페이지 읽어요.

sentences.text: I like this part of my night routine the most since I'm a huge bookworm.
sentences.text_ko: 책을 워낙 좋아해서 이 시간이 밤 루틴 중에 제일 좋아요.

sentences.text: When I start feeling sleepy, I blow out the candle and go to bed.
sentences.text_ko: 슬슬 졸리기 시작하면 촛불을 끄고 잠자리에 들어요.

sentences.text: Before settling in, I take my vitamins and wash them down with some water.
sentences.text_ko: 자기 전에 비타민을 먹고 물로 삼켜요.

sentences.text: Every night after putting on my PJs, I wash my face and take all my makeup off.
sentences.text_ko: 매일 밤 잠옷 입고 나면 세안하고 화장을 다 지워요.

full_transcript: Day 3 – Night Routine Every night after putting on my PJs, I wash my face and take all my makeup off. I start by removing my eyeliner and mascara with some makeup remover. Then I cleanse my face with a foam cleanser. After I rinse off all the cleanser, I pat my face dry with a towel. Next, I put on some moisturizer. For the final step of my skincare routine, I apply a bit of eye cream to help prevent wrinkles. Once my face is nice and clean, I light a candle. I love how cozy they make my house feel. Then I head to the kitchen to make a hot cup of tea. I fill the electric kettle and boil some water. I put a peppermint tea bag in my mug and pour the boiling water over it. After the tea cools down a bit, I take my first sip. While enjoying my tea, I journal and read a few pages of a book. I like this part of my night routine the most since I'm a huge bookworm. When I start feeling sleepy, I blow out the candle and go to bed. Before settling in, I take my vitamins and wash them down with some water.
